title: Tools are the platform
subtitle: Build the safety machinery once, make it the only path, and let everything else be a declaration

stats.label: tools behind one authenticated FAFOHive endpoint, under one trust model
steps in the frozen pipeline every Agent Swarm call passes
gateway actions compiled from YAML schemas into dispatch

lede: An agent is only as capable as the tools it can reach and only as safe as the path those tools take. I decided that the path would be built once, that it would be the only path, and that adding capability would be a matter of declaring a tool rather than writing a service. Validation, authorisation, limits, sanitisation, audit and observation happen in one pipeline for every call. A tool contributes its core behaviour and nothing else. An agent class is a composition of a tool subset, a policy, a workspace and a profile. One frozen pipeline in a fixed order. Tools declared as data.
quote: Exceptions are where the holes are.
evidence: Tool synthesis and governed API integration: one frozen pipeline of 12 steps for every call, with tools declared as data and compiled into dispatch so a tool is fully wired or the build fails.
MCP server design: 474 tools behind one authenticated endpoint under one trust model, and ~180 gateway actions compiled from YAML schemas.
Declarative agent definition: tools and personas defined as declarations, with hash-pinned catalogs so every host runs the same approved set.
author: Corey James
